reading.notes: POWER is the only LED with a bright, blown-out near-white core. ZONE 1 shows a distinct saturated green dot with a slightly lighter centre, but no white-hot core, so it counts as OFF under the stated rule. This call is borderline: it is noticeably brighter than ZONE 2/3, so it may be a dimly lit LED rather than pure bleed. ZONE 2 and ZONE 3 are dark grey with no glow.
